subject: Social Media
title: YouTube's Empire
description: A quick win: understand YouTube's Empire.

hook.text: YouTube launched in 2005 with a video of a guy at the zoo. Now it hosts 800 million videos and rivals TV.

buildup.text: Google bought it for $1.65 billion in 2006. Analysts called it crazy. YouTube now earns $30 billion yearly.

discovery.text: YouTube's recommendation engine drives 70% of views. You don't find videos—they find you. The algorithm curates.

twist.text: The algorithm favors watch time, not quality. A 10-minute rant beats a 2-minute gem. Length is rewarded.

climax.text: YouTube created new careers, new media, and new politics. It's the world's second-largest search engine.

punchline.text: A video site became a world stage.

quiz.question: What percentage of YouTube views are driven by recommendations?
